name: vico-home
description: Owner-controlled local Zigbee2MQTT light control for Codex, independent of VICO Core.

interface.shortDescription: Control your own lights from Codex on your LAN.
interface.longDescription: A local-only smart-home plugin. Configure your own supported devices and credentials outside the plugin; inspect device state and control explicitly authorized lights. Installing the plugin does not discover, configure, or control devices.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up VICO Home with my own supported light.
List the lights I configured in VICO Home and check their status.
